title: HtmlI
responsibility: Renders the native i element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlI.attributes
inputs.description: Native i attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlI.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native i element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlI
outputs.description: The actual native i element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
